fair_value_reason: P/E: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Oct-2027 ~$3.97 (1/4 FY27 ~$3.57 + 3/4 FY28 ~$4.10, from a verified ~$3.03 2026E) x 28x = $111, no cash add because EPS already includes ~$0.22/share of interest income (70%). FCF: horizon FCF ~$380M less ~$24M after-tax interest less ~$58M share-settlement taxes = ~$300M at a 3.0% yield = $10.0B, plus ~$0.76B net cash, over ~109M diluted shares = ~$99 (30%). Blend ~$108. Corrections vs agents: the four FCF legs that add cash to interest-inclusive FCF overstate by ~$6-7/share; settlement taxes run ~$55-62M/yr (FY2025 $41.9M, 84% in H1), not ~$100M as I said in round 1; agent_3's '$250-270M' FCF base is below FY2025's $333M. $108 is ~$2 below the agents' mean ($110) and ~3.5% below the $111.97 close.

thesis_triggers.event: A sustained close below ~$72 is ~18x NTM EPS of ~$3.97 and ~10% under the March ($79.73) and September ($80.39) closing lows, levels the stock held through the -21% April print and the summer DOJ/sector selloff. Getting there would most likely need a fundamental break: a guided product-revenue decline (RDIMM units contracting or MRDIMM/RCD share loss to Montage, which is already shipping MRCD/MDB), a royalty-renewal shortfall with a top licensee (top two ~38-40% of revenue), or a DOJ indictment or forced change to licensing practices.

supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasters cluster at $107-114 (mean $110), but the clustering mostly reflects inputs they took from my round-1 file, so it is not five independent confirmations. The filings show four of them double count ~$7/share by adding net cash to an FCF that already contains interest income, and that share-settlement taxes run ~$55-62M a year; correcting both puts fair value near $108 (~28x NTM EPS of ~$3.97), about 3.5% below the $111.97 close. I lower the 12-month ladder 1-1.5 points in the middle (median ~$111) and the 1-month ladder ~1 point into a late-October print that follows a +28.7% 15-session run-up, after which 5 of 8 past prints fell. There is no checked edge over the S&P 500; any position should be small, start after the Q3 print, and count as more AI-datacenter exposure alongside AVGO and GOOGL.
key_drivers: Multiple: the stock is ~32x current NTM EPS (~$3.45); fair value needs ~28x on ~$3.97 NTM EPS at Oct-2027, so the 12-month return is close to EPS growth minus de-rating.
2027 RDIMM unit growth (Baird 12-15%) and the MRDIMM ramp on AMD Venice and the delayed Diamond Rapids, with Montage already shipping MRCD/MDB (+80.7% y/y new products in H1).

Cash conversion: FY2025 FCF $333M; ~$24M/yr after-tax interest and ~$55-62M/yr of share-settlement taxes mean owner FCF ex-interest is only ~$300M at the horizon, which caps the FCF-based value near $100.
Late-October Q3 print after a +28.7% 15-session run-up: 5 of 8 prints after >9% run-ups fell, and 8 of the last 12 overall.
The DOJ Antitrust Division criminal grand-jury probe (10-Q risk factor since Q1 2026, no developments), an undatable left tail.
